notes.title: [Major Update] Part 2 "Blue Octave" released! 30% off sale now on!

notes.title: Development Report May 2025
notes.content:
Hello, this is Ekoda Bucho, the representative of the Alaska Crossing Department.
This is this month's development report.

This month, we continued to work on the implementation of version 0.90.
In this report, we will reveal the new system that will be implemented in version 0.90.

■Lapel pin

These accessories can be obtained when units meet certain conditions.
They have much higher performance than regular accessories.

The performance of lapel pin varies greatly depending on the unit that meets the conditions to obtain them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/6f758399701f9bc9e4d070e9ed4477b697dc38fe.png[/img]


With this implementation, the system improvements for version 0.90 are almost complete,
and the only remaining work is adjusting the stage data, etc.

It will likely take a little more time until version 0.90 is complete,
but we will announce it on the store page and on X once the release date has been confirmed.


We will continue to work hard on updates for the official release.
If you have any requests regarding the game, please contact us.
Reviews/Discussions, please send us your requests!

notes.title: Development Report April 2025
notes.content:
We apologize for the length of time since our last development report.
Over the past five months, we have been working on implementing systems for version 0.90.

In this report, we will be revealing the new systems that will be implemented in version 0.90.


■EX Map

A special free map that appears once you have progressed a certain amount in the story.
In an EX map, a specific unit is forced into battle, and a story related to that character is depicted.

Also, when you clear an EX map, a new unit may join you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/dd53fe093f4ebeffa0e465ed79594d01564d7e5c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/aa429294dcbdcfc4939a4ff630fb1f9b71fe0ebe.png[/img]

In previous versions, all new units joined automatically as the scenario progressed,
but from version 0.90 onwards, more units will join in EX maps.



We will continue to work hard on updates for the official release.

notes.title: "Dramatic Road : the origin of wind" Notice of change in official release date
notes.content:
■Regarding the Postponement of the Official Release

We had originally aimed to officially release the SRPG Dramatic Road: the origin of wind, currently available in early access, by the end of 2024. However, due to the time needed for improving quality in various areas exceeding our expectations, it has become difficult to complete the third part within this year.

As a result, we have decided to postpone the official release to 2025.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and for keeping those of you who have been patiently awaiting the official release waiting even longer.


■Regarding the Release of "Part 2"

On the other hand, we plan to implement the Version 0.90 update and release "Part 2" in January 2025.

Initially, we aimed to release both Part 2 and Part 3 simultaneously. However, considering the current situation, we have decided that it would not be right to delay any further without adding to the main story.

With the implementation of Part 2, most of the characters who have yet to appear will become playable, and you will be able to enjoy more advanced battles and character development compared to Part 1. Please look forward to it!


Once the release date for the Version 0.90 update is confirmed, we will notify you accordingly.

We will continue to work diligently on the implementation and updates as we move toward completion. We greatly appreciate your continued support.

notes.title: Development Report February 2024
notes.content:
Starting this month, we will be providing monthly updates on the progress of our development.

Without further ado, here is the development report for February 2024.

Currently, we are working on producing content beyond STAGE14 while simultaneously preparing for feature enhancements for Version 0.63.

The new features scheduled for implementation in Version 0.63 primarily include the following three:


■ L1/R1 Button Support
We will be adding compatibility for the L1/R1 buttons on the controller. This will make it convenient for checking the abilities of multiple units and enhancing actions. For those using keyboard and mouse controls, similar operations can be performed using the [Q] and [E] keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/b4184e54a41e50d511e0e1f8ac772c01f78340b3.png[/img]

■ Auto Enhancement
A new command, "Auto Enhancement," will be introduced in the action enhancement system. With a single button press, enhancements using AcP will be executed automatically. This feature is handy for quickly strengthening abilities when you want to streamline the enhancement process.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/9091505fc4137bb80cd10256fba15941655d2596.png[/img]

■ Shop
To address the perceived limited utility of "funds," we are implementing a new use for funds called the "Shop." By spending funds, players will be able to purchase various accessories of their choice, providing an additional avenue for resource utilization.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43637055/98b6b03812180a53811d128a4bad4c048b4d3f23.png[/img]

In addition, we plan to make minor fixes in Version 0.63. The update for Version 0.63 is scheduled to be implemented in the middle of February.

We will continue to work diligently towards the official release and appreciate any feedback or requests related to the game. Please feel free to submit your suggestions on the review board or bulletin board. Your input is valuable as we strive to enhance the gaming experience. Thank you for your ongoing support!

When loading save data from Ver 0.54 or earlier in an environment of Ver 0.60 or later,
A process that initializes the action learning status of all ally units will work.
At this time, all consumed AcP will be returned.

Please note that this process also occurs when loading data during battle.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to players due to the revised specifications.
I am very sorry.

------------------------------------------------

We will continue to expand functionality in preparation for the official release.
If you notice anything while playing, please let us know your opinions and requests on the review/bulletin board, etc.

notes.content:
Modern Japan Simulation RPG "Dramatic Road the origin of  wind"
Today we released the early access version!

To celebrate the release, we are having a 15% discount sale for a week!
If you are interested in SRPG, please take this opportunity to pick up this work!

In this work, we talk about three years of fierce battles between boys and girls in a three-part story.

The early access version includes "Part 1: Murakumo Alliance".

We would like to hear your play feedback to make the game even better.
